g.text: G7: salamander-group composition and frog calling

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444c55

g.text: 4,248 sites · 63,180 visits · 56 geographic blocks · both SDM backgrounds use the same observations
Primary comparison: two tiger salamanders versus two other Ambystoma, with newts separate.
95% intervals: 999 block refits (A); 999 paired block resamples of saved predictions (B). Open squares: fixed pooled-newt sensitivity.
Suitability contrasts do not measure local larval duration or arrival time.
